Must remain same Story with material/minor update semantics, not be split into a new Story. expected_delta_family intentionally left unasserted: 'Красный Бор' (a location) and 'пожарные работают' (a responder-status fact) are not claim TYPES services/fact_safety.py::extract_claims() recognizes (money/percentage/date/metric_quantity only) - achieving a literal material_update classification for this case would require extending the Delta Engine's claim vocabulary, a new-feature change explicitly out of scope this checkpoint. Current uncertain_delta (not suppressed, not lost) is an acceptable, disclosed, fail-open outcome.

special_investigation_cases.new_title: Apple пообещала открыть для Windows доступ к буферу обмена iPhone
special_investigation_cases.root_title: Apple plans to open iPhone clipboard access to Windows PCs
special_investigation_cases.notes: INVESTIGATED (Checkpoint 6): the two titles very likely describe the same real announcement (Apple + iPhone clipboard + Windows access, matching facts, differing only by language) - a human reader's own conclusion from the text alone. However, the deterministic pipeline has no translation/cross-language capability (a real, structural, out-of-scope limitation - keyword/title overlap is computed on raw tokens, so the Russian and English word forms share almost nothing lexically), so it cannot itself confirm 'no material delta' with confidence. Conclusion: UNCERTAIN is the correct, evidence-honest classification for this fixture - not because the same-story judgment is wrong, but because the system's own available evidence cannot verify it. The current behavior (uncertain_match, uncertain_delta, would_suppress=False - fail-open) is therefore already correct and was not changed for this case.
